🚀 We are hiring: Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer (CPO)


📍 Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai / Delhi NCR

Compensation: Significant founder-level equity + Competitive salary + Long-term wealth creation opportunity


About Minipix:

Minipix is building a vernacular-first micro-drama platform for Bharat. We believe the next wave of digital entertainment will come from Tier 2, Tier 3, and rural India, not English-speaking metro audiences.

We are looking for a Co-Founder & CPO to help build the product, team, and company from the ground up.


🛠️ What You Will Own

Product Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term roadmap, translate Bharat consumer insights into product experiences, and build a habit-forming platform that drives engagement and retention.


Growth & Monetisation: Design user acquisition, engagement, and retention loops. Build gamification systems and develop monetisation models (Micro-transactions, Sachet pricing, Subscriptions, and Hybrid models). Optimise key metrics like retention, DAU, and LTV.


Product, Engineering & Design Leadership: Build and lead product, engineering, and design functions. Create lightweight, scalable products for low-end Android devices and ensure an exceptional user experience for first-time internet users.


Company Building: Participate in strategic decision-making as a co-founder, shape culture, recruit world-class talent, and act as the face of the company to raise funds from top-tier VCs.


👤 Who You Are

Proven Consumer Product Leader: 10–12+ years of PM experience, with a track record of scaling consumer mobile apps to millions of users. Backgrounds in OTT, short video, social media, gaming, or consumer internet are highly preferred.


Deep Understanding of Bharat: Strong intuition for Tier 2/3 consumer behaviour, regional content consumption patterns, multilingual audiences, and empathy for low-bandwidth/low-end device environments.


Exceptional Communicator & Storyteller: Able to communicate product vision clearly to investors, founders, and teams, translating user feedback into actionable requirements.


Founder Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity, possessing a fierce bias for action, rapid experimentation, and a focus on outcomes over processes.


🎁 Why Join?

Founder-Level Ownership: Significant equity stake and a direct hand in shaping company strategy.


Massive Market Opportunity: Build for the next 500 million internet users and create a new entertainment category.


Build from Day One: Leave a lasting impact by creating systems, processes, and culture from scratch.


Partner with an Ambitious Founder: Co-create the vision and execution roadmap with a highly driven partner.


🎯 Ideal Background: High-scale consumer internet, OTT, short-video, gaming, or audio streaming.


📧 Interested or know someone who fits?

DM me directly or drop a line at

brijesh@minipix.in

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly entrepreneurial and technically strong Head of Product & Commercialisation to lead an AI-enabled B2B SaaS platform in the ESG, Sustainability, and LegalTech space. The product is already live, funded, and solving emerging challenges across large digital platforms.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping product vision, driving adoption, and preparing the business for scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive product strategy, roadmap, positioning, packaging, and commercialization.
  • Lead product innovation through customer discovery, market research, and feature ideation.
  • Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies and product launches.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, APIs, integrations, workflows, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and execution plans.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem partners, agencies, and strategic stakeholders.
  • Leverage customer feedback, market insights, and product data to drive decision-making.
  • Support business growth, market expansion, and long-term scaling initiatives.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software environments.
  • Proven experience building, launching, or scaling SaaS platforms or technology products.
  • Strong Technical Product Management experience, including APIs, integrations, workflows, platform products, and data-driven solutions.
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
  • Experience with product launches, GTM strategy, commercialization, and market adoption.
  • Mandatory ESG and Sustainability domain experience.
  • Proven experience working with ESG reporting, Sustainability platforms, ESG ratings, Governance frameworks, Compliance solutions, or related ESG-focused products.
  • Strong customer discovery, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work directly with founders and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced, and ambiguous environments.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or intelligent workflow platforms.
  • Experience with LegalTech, RegTech, ComplianceTech, Governance, Risk, or regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or merchant-facing products.
  • Background in product marketing, pricing strategy, partnerships, or international product launches.


Why Consider This Opportunity

descriptionHtml:
We're partnering with a premium consumer and hospitality company that has built a family of much-loved brands across dining, retail, and experiences. Over the last decade they have earned something rare: people came for the food, and stayed for the feeling.


As the business enters its next phase, they are looking for a senior leader to build the layer that deepens that relationship. Someone who can bring together customer data, CRM, loyalty, community, and AI, not as a set of systems, but as a way to make guests feel known, looked after, and genuinely closer to the brand.

This role reports directly to the founders. The operational foundation, the systems that run the business day to day, is already in place, held by a strong internal team. Your job is to build the growth and experience layer on top of it: the part that turns affection into a lasting, connected relationship across every brand.


What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the company's guest data, CRM, loyalty, and engagement strategy, with a view of loyalty that is about trust and belonging, not just points
  • Build a single, connected view of the guest across brands, channels, and touchpoints, without ever making the experience feel cold or transactional
  • Partner with marketing, CX, content, and business teams to deepen customer journeys, retention, and community
  • Use AI, automation, and technology thoughtfully, where it genuinely improves marketing, retention, service, and decision-making, never for its own sake
  •  Evaluate and bring in the right tools, platforms, and partnerships to support long-term growth, building on the foundation already in place
  • Sit with the founders on the bigger questions: what loyalty and community really mean for a hospitality brand, and how technology can amplify hospitality rather than replace it


What We're Looking For

  • 6 to 12 years across Product, CRM, Customer Experience, Loyalty, Growth, Martech, or Customer Data
  • A track record of building engagement, retention, loyalty, or personalisation initiatives at real scale
  • Strong grasp of CRM ecosystems, customer data, and lifecycle marketing, and the ability to turn data into relationships, not just campaigns
  • Comfortable combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and working through an existing team rather than around it
  • Experience in consumer-facing businesses: retail, hospitality, food, D2C, lifestyle, or technology platforms
  • Hands-on experience with AI-driven customer experience or growth is a plus, not a requirement
  •  Most of all: you think of customers as guests, not data points, and you care about how a brand makes people feel. That instinct matters here more than any single tool on your CV.


Why Consider This Role?

  •  A direct partnership with the founders, on something they care about deeply
  • The chance to define a brand-new capability, on top of a foundation that is already built, so you are creating, not firefighting
  • Real influence over guest experience, loyalty, community, and growth across multiple brands
  •  A rare brief: use technology to make a beloved hospitality company more connected and more loved, without losing the warmth that built it


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn or write to work@allthingstalent.in

The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.
  • Work closely with fellow engineering, design, and business leadership to define our product vision and strategy across your product areas, and deliver tangible business outcomes.
  • Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
  • Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
  • Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
  • Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

  • Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
  • 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
  • A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
  • A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
  • Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
  • Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
  • Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

Good to have :

  • Experience working in regulated industries collaborating with legal, compliance, and customer support teams
  • Experience in software development or a sound understanding of technical architecture

Hiring Process:

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

  • Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
  • Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
  • Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
  • Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
  • Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
  • Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work:

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

  • Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
  • Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
  • Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

About SAP Business Network

At SAP Business Network, we strive to hire amazing people, engage them, and maintain a diverse workforce. Inclusion, collaboration, and respect for the individual are central to our values.

SAP Business Network is the largest B2B commerce and collaboration platform in the world, connecting millions of trading partners across procurement, logistics, asset management, and supply chain ecosystems. We are building the “Network of Intelligent Enterprises” – a unified, open, AI-powered business network that transforms how companies collaborate with their suppliers, logistics providers, contract manufacturers, and asset operators.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product Management for SAP Business Network Asset Collaboration (BNAC) to define and scale SAP’s next-generation asset collaboration platform. This role will own the end-to-end product strategy for BNAC, driving how asset-intensive industries (e.g., energy, utilities, manufacturing, aerospace & defense, chemicals) collaborate across asset lifecycles, partners, and ecosystems.

This is a market-making leadership role, not a feature-factory position. You will shape how SAP Business Network evolves into the leading platform for multi-enterprise asset visibility, collaboration, and intelligence — spanning maintenance, reliability, sustainability, compliance, and asset-centric supply chains.

You will lead a globally distributed team of senior product managers, partner deeply with engineering, design, and go-to-market leaders, and work directly with strategic customers to co-innovate differentiated capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for BNAC, aligned with SAP’s broader Business Network and SCM strategy.
  • Establish BNAC as the market-leading platform for multi-enterprise asset collaboration, spanning asset lifecycle management, maintenance collaboration, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Translate customer, industry, and ecosystem needs into differentiated, scalable product capabilities.

Product-Led Growth & Business Impact

  • Drive product-led growth by embedding adoption loops, network effects, and expansion paths into the BNAC experience.
  • Own growth metrics including customer adoption, engagement, expansion revenue, retention, and monetization of BNAC capabilities.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success to create compelling value propositions, packaging, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify and incubate new revenue streams across asset data services, analytics, sustainability, and partner-enabled ecosystems.

Customer & Ecosystem Leadership

  • Engage directly with strategic customers, industry consortia, and partners to shape requirements, secure design partnerships, and co-innovate.
  • Represent BNAC in executive briefings, customer councils, industry events, and analyst engagements.
  • Drive a strong ecosystem strategy across OEMs, MRO providers, asset operators, and digital solution partners.

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional execution across engineering, UX, data, and platform teams in a highly matrixed, global environment.
  • Ensure disciplined delivery of roadmap commitments with high quality, scalability, and security.
  • Establish clear product operating rhythms (OKRs, planning cycles, roadmap governance, prioritization frameworks).

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing global product organization with strong product craft, business acumen, and customer obsession.
  • Set a clear culture of accountability, empowerment, and ownership, with single-threaded leaders for major initiatives.
  • Coach product leaders on strategy, executive communication, and cross-functional influence.
  • Drive performance management, succession planning, and long-term capability building for the BNAC product team.

Market & Innovation Leadership

  • Monitor emerging trends across asset management, Industry 4.0, AI, sustainability, and network platforms.
  • Translate technology innovation (AI, analytics, digital twins, IoT integration) into actionable product opportunities.
  • Maintain a sharp competitive perspective and continuously refine BNAC’s differentiated positioning.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including leadership of enterprise or B2B platform products.
  • Deep domain expertise in asset management and asset-intensive industries (e.g., maintenance, reliability, lifecycle management, sustainability, compliance).
  • Proven track record of product-led growth, including driving adoption, monetization, and expansion for platform products.
  • Demonstrated success in building and scaling multi-enterprise or network-based products with strong customer and ecosystem adoption.
  • Strong people leadership experience, including leading senior product managers, building teams, and driving performance and career growth.
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; ability to influence without authority in complex matrixed organizations.
  • Experience working directly with strategic customers and partners in co-innovation or design-partner programs.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect product strategy to revenue, retention, and long-term platform value.
  • Highly adaptable, curious, and comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

If you are a visionary product leader energized by defining the future of multi-enterprise asset collaboration, driving product-led growth, and building a world-class product organization, this is your role.

Join SAP Business Network and help build the platform that will power the world’s most resilient, intelligent, and sustainable asset ecosystems.

Job Description: Program Manager – CEO/COO Office

Function: Business Operations | Execution Discipline | Revenue & Cross-Functional Tracking


Location- Mumbai

Reporting To- COO (with weekly reviews with the Founder/CEO)

Experience- 4–8 Years

Function- Business Operations / Program Management / Revenue Operations

Company- Pinkvilla

Role Type- Hands-on Execution and Operating Cadence


Role Overview

Pinkvilla is looking for a hands-on Program Manager to drive execution discipline across Revenue, Content, Video, Social, Marketing, Product, and Business Operations.

This role is for someone who can bring structure to a fast-moving media business, ensure cross-functional tasks are closed on time, and help leadership track priorities, owners, deadlines, blockers, and outcomes.

This is not a passive coordination or strategy-only role. The person must actively drive closure, follow up across teams, and escalate risks with solutions and options.


Key Responsibilities

1. Cross-Functional Execution Tracking

  • Own the master tracker for key company priorities across Revenue, Content, Video, App, Social, Marketing, Product, and Operations.
  • Convert meetings into clear action items with owners, timelines, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
  • Follow up daily and weekly with stakeholders to ensure task closure.
  • Highlight delays, blockers, and missed deadlines proactively.


2. Revenue and Sales Execution Support

  • Track sales-related subtasks, including proposals, decks, pricing, content deliverables, campaign requirements, client commitments, and closure timelines.
  • Maintain a weekly revenue action tracker with Sales, Finance, Content, and Operations teams.
  • Ensure sales dependencies from Content, Social, and Video teams are completed on time.
  • Support leadership with visibility into signed deals, verbal commitments, proposals in progress, and at-risk revenue.


3. Platform and Content Operating Cadence

  • Help run weekly reviews for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Social, App, and Video/Content growth initiatives.
  • Track platform metrics, content calendars, output commitments, and monetization-linked action items.
  • Ensure platform owners report progress against agreed metrics and action plans.


4. Leadership Review and Reporting

  • Prepare concise weekly updates for the COO/CEO covering:
  • Completed actions
  • Delayed items
  • Key blockers
  • Escalations
  • Priorities for the upcoming week
  • Maintain dashboards and trackers that provide leadership with a clear view of business execution.
  • Ensure decisions from leadership meetings are documented and followed through.


5. Escalation and Blocker Management

  • Identify cross-functional dependencies early and escalate unresolved blockers with solutions, not just problems.
  • Push for closure without requiring constant supervision.
  • Create accountability without creating unnecessary meetings.


Expected Deliverables in the First 30–60 Days


Area Expected Output

Master Company Tracker

Priorities, owners, due dates, status updates, blockers, and escalations

Revenue Tracker

Sales subtasks, client deliverables, closure timelines, and risks

Platform Review Tracker

YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Social, App actions, and outcomes

Weekly Leadership Update

Concise COO/CEO summary covering completed actions, delays, blockers, and key asks

Escalation Process

Visibility into delays, reasons, ownership, and required interventions

Meeting Discipline

Fewer vague meetings and clearer action-oriented outcomes


Requirements

  • 4–8 years of experience in Program Management, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, Content Operations, Digital Media Operations, or Startup Operations.
  • Strong ability to manage cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent follow-up discipline and comfort driving closure across teams.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
  • Ability to create trackers, dashboards, weekly updates, and action plans.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work directly with senior leadership and drive accountability respectfully.
  • Prior experience in Media, Content, Creator Economy, Digital Platforms, Advertising, Entertainment, or Consumer Internet businesses is preferred.


Good to Have

  • Experience working with Revenue and Sales teams.
  • Understanding of digital content platforms such as YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and short-video ecosystems.
  • Experience in media monetization, branded content, social media operations, or campaign execution.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Sheets, Excel, Notion, Asana, Trello, Jira, Slack, or similar project management platforms.


Traits We Are Looking For

  • Highly organized
  • Detail-oriented
  • Execution-focused
  • Fast in follow-ups
  • Persistent without being abrasive
  • Clear communicator
  • Comfortable with ambiguity
  • Able to work directly with founders and senior leadership
  • Strong ownership mindset
  • Not afraid to follow up with senior stakeholders to drive closure


What This Role Is Not

  • Not a passive coordination role.
  • Not a meeting-notes role.
  • Not a strategy-only role.
  • Not a traditional PMO role focused solely on project tracking.

This person must actively drive execution, accountability, and closure across the organization.

Explore our journey and offerings here: https://accredian.com/


About Accredian

Accredian is a fast growing edtech company that was started in 2018 by ISB MBAs. The company has so far served 18,000+ professionals working in almost 3000 companies. Accredian arms working professionals with next generation skills like Strategy, Leadership, Finance, HR, Data Science, Digital Transformation, Business Management, Product management in partnership with top tier institutions like IITs, IIMs, XLRI and provides them a transformative learning experience to help them move up in their careers.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and deliver high-impact sessions on business strategy, competitive advantage, growth strategy, market expansion, and business model innovation, tailored to the maturity and function of each executive cohort.
  • Lead discussion-based and simulation-driven learning experiences that help executives develop strategic thinking as a practiced discipline, not a theoretical exercise.
  • Develop original case studies, strategic frameworks, and business challenges drawn from diverse industries, geographies, and market contexts.
  • Facilitate leadership conversations on transformation, organisational disruption, and adaptive strategy, bridging strategic intent with execution realities.
  • Challenge participants to pressure-test their assumptions and build well-reasoned strategic positions, using Socratic inquiry and structured debate where appropriate.


Required Experience & Skills:

Minimum 15 years of experience at the intersection of strategy and leadership, in consulting, corporate strategy, or equivalent senior management roles.

  • Depth in one or more of: business strategy, competitive strategy, growth strategy, market entry, digital transformation, corporate restructuring, or innovation management.
  • Proven experience facilitating executive-level learning for audiences with 10-25 years of professional experience. Comfort managing strong opinions and navigating intellectual conflict constructively.
  • Ability to synthesise ideas across industries and business contexts, and to make strategic frameworks immediately actionable for practicing executives.
  • Strong narrative ability and executive presence; capable of commanding attention through insight and clarity, not just authority.
  • MBA from a top-tier institution or equivalent advanced degree; doctoral qualification or research credentials a distinct advantage.


Teaching & Facilitation Expectations:

  • Strategy sessions at Accredian are expected to be intellectually provocative. Participants arrive with strong opinions, your role is to sharpen, challenge, and constructively disrupt them.
  • Facilitate through cases, simulations, structured group exercises, and live strategic problem-solving, not extended lectures. The energy in the room is your responsibility.
  • Sessions must translate to takeaways that participants can apply to their organisations within weeks.
  • Adaptability is essential: cohorts may include functional managers, business unit heads, entrepreneurs, and C-suite leaders, often in the same room. Faculty must calibrate accordingly.
  • Comfort with online delivery (virtual) is required. Proficiency with digital facilitation tools is an advantage.


Preferred Candidate Profiles:

  • We are open to multiple archetypes, what is non-negotiable is the ability to elevate a room of experienced leaders. Profiles that fit this role well include:
  • Strategy Consultant or Managing Partner from a leading consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or equivalent) who has transitioned into executive facilitation, guest faculty, or advisory roles.
  • Former CEO, COO, or Chief Strategy Officer with a career defined by transformation mandates and a hunger to transfer strategic instinct to the next generation of leaders.
  • Business School Faculty with a focus on competitive strategy, corporate strategy, or innovation, ideally with active consulting engagements and a track record in executive programs over traditional classroom settings.
  • Professor of Practice or Executive-in-Residence with a hybrid career spanning strategy consulting or leadership in large enterprises, capable of grounding theory in lived organisational complexity.

About the Team:

  • You will be part of a high-impact team that partners closely with Solifi’s global engineering and products teams and other business functions. The team plays a critical role in shaping the company’s growth journey by building scalable people practices, enabling leaders, and fostering a high-performance, ownership-driven culture.
  • We operate in a fast-paced, product-led environment where agility, data-driven decisions, and strong collaboration are key. The team is lean, strategic, and embedded with business stakeholders—focusing not just on HR processes, but on partnering with the business to solve problems and build culture.


About the Position:

As a HR Business Partner, you will act as a strategic advisor to the chief technology officer (CTO), chief product officer (CPO) and leadership teams across their organizations to drive the people strategy. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

You will work closely with senior leaders to design org structures, improve team effectiveness, in alignment with Solifi’s strategy and goals. The position demands a proactive approach, strong business acumen, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity while scaling teams and processes.


Role and Responsibilities:

  • In this role, you will partner closely with business and functional leaders to translate organizational goals into impactful people strategies that drive growth and team effectiveness.
  • You will play a key role in shaping org structures, enabling workforce planning, and ensuring teams are designed to scale efficiently in a fast-paced product environment.
  • You will partner with leaders and HR colleagues to deliver effective performance management and calibration processes, while also building strong succession pipelines and identifying high-potential talent across teams.
  • A significant part of your role will involve coaching managers and leaders on improving team performance, leadership effectiveness, and decision-making.
  • You will actively contribute to building a strong employee experience by driving engagement initiatives, fostering a culture of feedback and accountability, and addressing employee concerns with a balanced, business-first approach.
  • You will also handle sensitive employee relations matters with maturity and confidentiality, ensuring fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Working closely with the talent acquisition team, you will support hiring strategies and workforce plans. You will also focus on onboarding effectiveness, internal mobility, and career development frameworks to retain and grow talent within the organization.
  • Additionally, you will leverage data and analytics to monitor key HR metrics such as attrition, engagement, and performance trends, using these insights to influence leadership decisions and drive continuous improvement across teams.
  • Your ability to combine data with business context will be critical in identifying opportunities and proactively solving people-related challenges.


About You

Experience & Background

  • 8+ years of HR experience with at least 4 years in an HRBP role
  • Exposure to supporting Product, Engineering, or Tech teams
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect HR to business outcomes
  • Demonstrated success delivering results in a matrix organization
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in HR analytics
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with a global team
  • Proactive, ownership-driven, and comfortable with ambiguity
  • Ability to operate both strategically and hands-on
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Passion for building culture and enabling people success
